<!-- Tasks are created with the backlog CLI; this shows what a good one contains.
     backlog task create "<title>" -p <EPIC-ID> --type <type> -m "<milestone>" --ac "<criterion>" --dep <ID> -->

## Description

Why and what, in 10 lines or fewer. Link the epic's spec requirement if there is one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] #1 An observable result (test, command output, behaviour), not an activity
- [ ] #2 For a feature: how it gets what it needs from the project (Claude reads it, or Truing asks the person), with no config
- [ ] #3 …

## Implementation plan

Written just before coding, 30 lines or fewer, or "See docs/changes/<ID>-<slug>/plan.md".

## Implementation notes

An append-only log of decisions and surprises (`--append-notes`).

## Final summary

What changed, how it was verified (commands and results), and the IDs of follow-up tasks.
